quantile_definition: delta_base = q0.5 of D_ij pooled over the final 2 epoch(s) of a 8-epoch beta=0 window; gamma set so a q0.95 edge attenuates to w = 0.5 (SPEC Sec. 11 / D6)
note: DERIVED, NOT MEASURED. delta_base = 2.0x the calibrated value from window 8 (0.076916 -> 0.153832); gamma carried over unchanged. Added per SPEC Sec. 16 / D17 to test the LOOSE-gate direction, which the measured grid does not reach. Pre-outcome and strictly harder for the hypothesis: a looser gate is closer to NaiveDistill, so a benefit that survives here is not attributable to gating.
